summary: PRA Group filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, announcing a proposed private offering of $400.0 million of senior notes due 2033, exempt under Rule 144A/Reg S. Proceeds, plus cash, will repay roughly $400.0 million drawn under the North American revolving credit facility. The notes are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by domestic subsidiaries that borrow or guarantee the North American Credit Agreement. No price, coupon, or closing date was stated. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; watch pricing, leverage, and whether the deal upsizes.
